title: AccountStatusChangedPayload

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

status.description: What an account's status read found: signed-in (it can run), signed-out, expired (the provider says its login has lapsed), unreadable (the provider read failed), or unavailable (a deadline elapsed; automatically retried). Only a signed-in account runs.

previous.description: What an account's status read found: signed-in (it can run), signed-out, expired (the provider says its login has lapsed), unreadable (the provider read failed), or unavailable (a deadline elapsed; automatically retried). Only a signed-in account runs.

detail.description: Why, when the read said: the provider's error or a temporary deadline and retry diagnostic.

description: account.status-changed: a status read found the account in another state than the last; appended only on a change.
